scope_limit: Five supplied documents read directly. Commit a411de6 and the referenced bundle are not reachable from this repository; harness/pregame_personnel.py and the registry were not inspected. Numeric claims below were verified arithmetically against the supplied views and this repo's staged WNBA bytes.

headline_finding.title: The active WNBA card silently moved from v0.4 to v0.5 with materially different numbers, inside a release described as personnel-context-only
headline_finding.detail: The release note says 'Original gradeable predictions preserved; no duplicate ledger rows or probability rewrites', and the view file itself says probabilities are 'the already registered, gradeable claims'. Both statements are true ONLY relative to a 20:15:30Z card that was never announced. The card registered at 06:56:12Z (v0.4) carried NYL@IND 72.2%/+7.4/166.1, WAS@LVA 47.7%/+1.1/152.2, PHX@LA 23.7%/-3.2/160.4. The view binds a 20260811T201530Z card with 78.7%/+9.2/177.4, 56.7%/+2.9/163.6, 48.4%/-0.2/173.7 — moves of +6.5pp, +9.0pp and +24.7pp, with totals up a near-uniform +11.3 to +13.3 points. The operating guide mentions 'the current WNBA v0.5' only in passing.
headline_finding.what_it_is_not: NOT an R3 violation, assuming the v0.5 card was registered append-only before tip with v0.4 preserved — which the ledger conventions described would produce. The rows were not rewritten; a successor was issued.
headline_finding.what_it_is: A model transition with a 24.7pp output change on one game, shipped without a status record, walk-forward validation, preregistration reference, or supersession record — discoverable only by diffing the view against the morning's card. The v0.3->v0.4 transition got an incident record and a lineage block; v0.4->v0.5 got a parenthetical.
required: the v0.5 STATUS record (analogous to WNBA_RS_FF_0_4_STATUS.json) with walk-forward metrics, preregistration reference and lineage/supersession block
confirmation of the v0.5 registration timestamp relative to the 23:30Z first tip
what changed between v0.4 and v0.5, stated as a diff of frozen choices, not inferred by an auditor

verified_improvements_in_v05.note: Whatever v0.5 is, its numbers now pass the checks v0.4 failed — consistent with implementing this repo's audit recommendations.
verified_improvements_in_v05.coherence_gate: direct-vs-margin divergence at empirical sd 13.97: NYL@IND +4.2pp, WAS@LVA -1.5pp, PHX@LA -1.0pp. All three inside 5pp; v0.4's worst was 17.2pp and its sign disagreement is gone.
verified_improvements_in_v05.level_shift: totals moved +11.3/+11.4/+13.3 — the near-uniform league scoring-level correction that audit finding M2 predicted would be the fix. v0.4's 152.2 sat 18 points under the market line; v0.5's totals sit 5-13 under, plausible for a market-blind model.
verified_improvements_in_v05.caveat: Passing coherence is necessary, not sufficient. Whether v0.5's changes were preregistered before seeing v0.4's audit failures, and whether its walk-forward still clears the primary gate, is exactly what the missing status record must show.

grading_cohort_rule_frozen_before_finals.why_now: Tonight's three games tip from 23:30Z. There are now (at least) three registered cards for the same slate: v0.3 (superseded incident), v0.4 (06:56Z), v0.5 (20:15Z). Without a rule frozen BEFORE results, tomorrow's summary can quote whichever version scored better — the exact post-hoc selection this system has already retracted once.
rule: ALL registered rows are graded: v0.3, v0.4 and v0.5 each against the same tier-1 finals.
v0.5 is the ACTIVE claim of record for 2026-08-11; v0.4 grades in a SUPERSEDED_PRE_TIP cohort; v0.3 in SUPERSEDED_INCIDENT.

No citation of tonight's outcome may quote one cohort without the others. In particular, if v0.4's PHX@LA (23.7%) happens to score better than v0.5's (48.4%), that is a coin flip on n=1 and confers nothing on v0.4.
n=3 resolves nothing about either model. The grades are ledger maintenance.

observation_recorded_not_asserted.phx_las_line_flip_candidate_cause: Yesterday's capture had PHX -1 (Caesars); today's owner board has LAS -2.5 — a ~3.5-point move toward LA that this repo flagged as unexplained.
